relationships.subject: BSRE
relationships.evidence_quote: BSRE administration markedly upregulated the expression of COL2A1 and aggrecan while concurrently reducing levels of nitric oxide, prostaglandin E2, leukotriene B4, interleukin (IL)-6, and tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-α.

relationships.subject: BSRE
relationships.evidence_quote: a substantial decrease was observed in the mRNA expression of inducible nitric oxide synthase, cyclooxygenase-2, 5-lipoxygenase, IL-6, TNF-α and MMP-3 and -13

key_findings: BSRE reduced inflammatory mediators and MMPs and protected cartilage in MIA osteoarthritis rats.
